title: cPacket Data Generator
summary: A collection of Python scripts for training a CTGAN model, generating synthetic tabular samples, and evaluating their quality against a reference dataset. The pipeline is built directly on SDV's CTGANSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, and evaluate_quality functions to fit, sample, and score the synthetic data.
